model_scope: Historical Astra actor campaign; simulator Astra low; native/model-based evaluators include historical version differences. Not a uniform-judge cross-model release.

bootstrap.unit: study within benchmark; same draws for all settings; trials averaged within question; equal benchmarks and equal four injected personas
bootstrap.resource_ratio: Ratio of equally benchmark-weighted persona and off means on the same common question panel; recompute numerator and denominator together in each draw; no per-question division or pseudocounts.

reported_metrics.source: User relayed measured values from collaborator who ran the experiment
reported_metrics.status: collaborator_reported; underlying metric records not available locally
reported_metrics.aggregation: Supplied for mean-persona main-table columns; exact extraction and weighting not independently verified

additional_models.note: Haiku actor and simulator: Claude Haiku 4.5; judge: GPT-6 Astra. Performance uses 200 questions (40 per benchmark), five settings, one trial, including 120 non-submissions; 95% intervals use the benchmark-stratified study-cluster bootstrap. Haiku fact recovery (67.95%) and self-repetition (21.43%) are collaborator-reported measurements and 95% confidence intervals supplied by the author on 2026-10-07. Their underlying metric records, exact aggregation, sample counts and CI computation method are not available locally; these estimates and intervals have not been independently reproduced. They replace the incorrectly labelled older Opus-simulator values. All non-Off columns represent the four-persona mean; performance weights benchmarks and personas equally.
